text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, influenced by a movie I 
happened to watch, I instinctively dropped 
by a bar, and there...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Trainer? ...Heheh, what a surprise! 
Fancy meeting you here!
choice_data_list:
I was watching a movie and saw a bar 
scene, you see

I was watching a movie and saw a bar 
scene, you see

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah-ha! So you wanted to imitate it 
yourself... is that it?! Man, I totally 
get that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
High barstools, bottles lined in a row... 
it's so badass, right?! Let's soak in this 
cool vibe together!

Fufu... Today once again, I hear the voice 
of a lost soul lured into this hideout—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Gim-senpai! ...Show us again today, 
that first-class shaker technique you 
polished up at your part-time gig!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hou... has that guest yonder also come to 
be intoxicated by none other than Me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With my heart pounding, I explained that I 
had come to experience the bar's 
atmosphere after admiring a scene from a 
movie...!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Kuku. Your order?
choice_data_list: In that case... a fruit mocktail, please!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... so you desire the forbidden 
fruit...!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pineapple... grape... O gems that have 
fully basked in the blessings of sunlight!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Awaken... mingle together... now is the 
hour of the banquet! The hour of the rondo 
of eternity and the soul's flesh and 
blood!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Listen closely! Get drunk on the sound! 
Haaah-hah-hah-hah-haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Tanino Gimlet seemed to 
be preparing the mocktail with practiced 
dexterity, but...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It is finished. Take your chalice.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—An original mocktail whispered to Me by 
the Goddess... "The Hollow Paradise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I cautiously reached out toward the glass 
Tanino Gimlet presented, but...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Elementary, my beloved guest.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The most pure, all-pervading distant 
fruit. Is it pineapple? Grape? ...Nay!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...It is the Void! ...Nothing other than 
the Void itself!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you are to get drunk on Me—substance is 
entirely unnecessary! 
...Haaah-hah-hah-hah-haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoaaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Super badass!! Whoooo!! That's Gim-senpai 
for ya! Don'tcha think so too?! Right?!
choice_data_list:
The shaker handling was pretty impressive, 
at least...
I-I can barely keep up with this...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
See, told ya! Told ya! Man, who even needs 
actual liquid inside!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Cling to your yearning! Be intoxicated by 
Me!! Taste the twist of infinite 
possibilities and brand new chaos! 
Haaah-hah-hah-hah-haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If someone could easily keep up, she 
wouldn't be Gim-senpai! True cool is 
unfathomable, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The great light sleeping in the abyss 
cannot be grasped so easily... Struggle! 
Seek it out! Haaah-hah-hah-hah-haaaah!
